subject: Money
title: The ICO Craze
description: Learn The ICO Craze in one minute.

hook.text: In 2017, a company raised $150 million in an ICO with a whitepaper and no product. It disappeared with the money.

buildup.text: Initial coin offerings let anyone create a token and sell it. Over $20 billion was raised in 2017-2018.

discovery.text: ICOs bypassed securities laws. No audits, no regulations, no investor protections. Buyer beware, literally.

twist.text: Eighty percent of ICOs were scams or failed projects. The SEC eventually declared most were illegal securities.

climax.text: The ICO craze mirrored the dot-com boom: revolutionary technology, zero due diligence, catastrophic losses.

punchline.text: A whitepaper is not a business plan.

quiz.question: What percentage of ICOs were scams or failed projects?
